description: This file defines a Python class 'ZscalerAIGuard' that integrates Zscaler AI Guard with a larger system, providing methods for applying guardrails to text inputs, handling API communication, and processing responses. It is part of a proxy guardrail hook implementation for content moderation.

classes.name: ZscalerAIGuard
classes.description: A class that implements a guardrail using Zscaler AI Guard, providing methods for applying guardrails to text inputs, making API calls, and processing responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ZscalerAIGuard with optional API parameters and environment variable defaults.

methods.name: _get_stripped_metadata_value
methods.description: Retrieves and strips a specific metadata value from request data.

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Applies the guardrail to a batch of texts, checking each via API and raising exceptions if blocked.

methods.name: extract_blocking_info
methods.description: Extracts transaction ID and blocking detectors from a guard response.

methods.name: _create_user_facing_error
methods.description: Creates an error dictionary for user-facing error messages.

methods.name: _prepare_headers
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for API requests, including optional user API key info.

methods.name: _send_request
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous HTTP POST request to the specified URL with headers and data.

methods.name: _handle_response
methods.description: Processes the API response, raising exceptions on errors or returning guard results.

methods.name: make_zscaler_ai_guard_api_call
methods.description: Performs the API call to Zscaler AI Guard and handles response parsing and errors.
